articles.translatedTitle: The cause is myself. , released the "Love Reason" performance video. Show off your charm with elegant formation and perfect expression management
articles.translatedExcerpt: The cause is myself. has released a performance video for their new song "Love Reason." "Love Reason" is the title song of the CD single to be released on November 11th, and the music is provided by Vocaloid P/singer-songwriter syudou. Expressed with the unique world view created by Syudou x Genjibu, it is a crazy love song full of love. The performance video released today is a bit different from the music video, as it is captured with camera work that directly conveys the passion and three-dimensionality of the dance itself. While the flowing beauty of the formation changes permeates throughout the song, pay attention to the powerful and supple dance that does not break even in the midst of intense developments, as well as the facial expression management that perfectly expresses the worldview of the song, which is a mixture of madness and love. In addition, the costume in this video is made of shiny fabric that seems to be wrapped in surrounding light, and is made of beads of the same color.

articles.translatedTitle: Hudson Westbrook releases new country song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Hudson Westbrook released his new album "Made You Look" on Friday, November 6, 2026. This follow-up to their 2025 debut album "Texas Forever" includes a total of 16 songs. This album is a condensation of his life, love, music activities, and feelings for his hometown of Texas, which has seen remarkable growth over the past two and a half years. This album embraces the charm of traditional country while incorporating modern sensibilities and free songwriting. It depicts not only his momentum as a young artist, but also his growth and struggles as a human being. articles.translatedExcerpt: YOASOBI has decided to release their new song "KILLA" on November 11th (Wednesday). This work is based on a novel born out of the ``Hajimete'' Literary Club, a program launched in 2022 as part of the ``Hajimete'' collaboration project with four Naoki Prize-winning authors, with the aim of discovering and nurturing new writers who will lead the next generation of literary circles. At the same time, the song jacket has also been released. The original novel is ``I Want to Kill Senpai, so I Dress as a Woman'' by Yoa Maeneko, who was a member of the first generation of ``The First Literary Club''. This work, which was released as a book on October 16th (Friday), is Maneko Yoa's debut work. In order to fulfill the wishes of the person he loves, a boy becomes the "ideal beautiful girl." A dangerous yet funny story that depicts the distortions and purity of love through the image of a boy who changes himself for the sake of the person he falls in love with.

articles.translatedTitle: Alyssa Grace releases personal and sensitive new song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Alyssa Grace released her new single "washing skin" on Friday, November 6, 2026. This work is more personal than ever, as she confronts the painful events she experienced in the past and the trauma deeply engraved in her heart. Through delicate musical expressions based on folk pop, he frankly depicts the experiences of hurt and the complex emotions that arise from them. This song was released by Artist House. articles.translatedTitle: Megan Moroney releases new acoustic song
articles.translatedExcerpt: Megan Moroney released her new single "You for Me (Smoky Mountain Demo)" on Friday, November 6, 2026. This song sings about the feeling that even though you have beautiful scenery and gorgeous experiences all over the world, what you are truly yearning for is only one person. The song is an acoustic number depicting earnest romantic feelings. This song is different from her 2026 album "Cloud 9", which incorporates a gorgeous pop sound, and highlights her charm as a songwriter. articles.translatedTitle: Sadie releases details and jacket for her first original album "PANDRA" in 12 years. For the first time in history, all five members composed the music
articles.translatedExcerpt: Sadie has revealed the contents and jacket artwork of her new album ``PANDRA'', which will be released on December 23rd. It has been 12 years since Sadie released an original album since 2014's "GANGSTA". This is their first work since resuming their activities, and for the first time in the band's history, all five members composed the music. Bringing their individual personalities together, the current Sadie is engraved into a total of 10 songs. Included are the single "Aku no Hana" released on September 23rd, as well as "Valhalla", "CRUEL", "DEVIL OR ANGEL", "Withered rain", "BLACK HOLE", "UNFAIR", "die in obscurity", "STAY REAL" and "Shirogane-". articles.excerpt: Sam Barberが2026年11月6日(金)にニューEP『Outlier』をリリースした。 全6曲で構成される本作は、4月に発表されたセカンドスタジオアルバム『Broken View』に続く最新プロジェクト。プロデューサーには、これまで“Indigo”や“Straight and Narrow”などを手がけてきたJoe Beckerを起用している。 カントリー、アメリカーナ、フォークを横断するSam Barberの音楽性をさらに掘り下げた本作。新たな音楽的章の幕開けを告げるリリースとなっている。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4414206 アーティスト情報 https://www.instagram.com/sambarber_music/
articles.translatedTitle: Sam Barber releases new EP with 6 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: Sam Barber released his new EP “Outlier” on Friday, November 6, 2026. This work, which consists of 6 songs in total, is the latest project following the second studio album "Broken View" released in April. The producer is Joe Becker, who has previously worked on songs such as "Indigo" and "Straight and Narrow." This work further delves into Sam Barber's musicality, which spans country, Americana, and folk. This release marks the beginning of a new musical chapter. articles.title: Shygirl、感情の変化をテーマにした新ALリリース

articles.translatedTitle: Shygirl releases new AL with the theme of emotional changes
articles.translatedExcerpt: Shygirl released their new album "SWALLOW!" on Friday, November 6, 2026. This is his first album in about 4 years since his debut album “Nymph” in 2022. The album contains 11 songs with themes of love, self-awareness, desire, and emotional changes. This work boldly incorporates elements of indie songwriting while building on the provocative and experimental club sounds of the past. This work presents a new musical frontier. articles.translatedTitle: nomi., new AL release containing 11 songs
articles.translatedExcerpt: nomi. released their new album ``This Wolf May Cry'' on Friday, October 30, 2026. She has attracted attention from SZA, Tyler, The Creator, Pharrell Williams, Kaytranada, and more. This is a full-length album that brings to fruition the musical identity that has been presented little by little through singles and EPs. Although it has a compact composition of 11 songs, approximately 30 minutes, it traverses modern R&B, neo-soul, alternative pop, and even a rhythm reminiscent of UK garage. With a soft, floating singing voice and a production with a unique blank space, it is a work that invites the listener to a slightly mysterious world of music. On the day of the event, they released their 4th single, ``Datte Daikyojan☆/Taunted Butte Cane, Aishitette Butte Cane,''. articles.translatedExcerpt: Sar mo waits released their new single "Nosei" on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. Sar mo waits, who released their debut single in July of this year, is already releasing their third new song, which is a work depicting a "breakup." The song has a sound reminiscent of 90's UK rock, with straightforward lyrics and a hymn-like chorus. In addition, the music video released today includes the first performance scene of the members since the start of their activities, and expresses the world view of the song through video. The rough-touch visuals and captions that give an early Heisei era feel fully express the musicality of the group, which aims to ``continue without being caught up in the times.'' articles.translatedTitle: God Doesn't Roll Dice, Starts New Label, Releases New Artwork, Releases Distribution Single "99"
articles.translatedExcerpt: God doesn't play dice, but he has launched a new independent label, ``Nighty Night,'' and will release the digital single ``99'' (pronounced: ninety-nine) on November 11th (Wednesday). Furthermore, to celebrate the launch of the label, they announced the release of a digital single and released a new photo. In the process of composing the distribution single "99", we pursued a more minimal sound approach than before, which was different from the band's previous sound. It depicts a real, non-special day-to-day life in which alone time is projected onto anyone, not a specific person. As Kami Sai's memorable first release under his new label, named "Nighty Night," the song was created to gently resonate with each of the artists' thoughts and feelings. articles.translatedTitle: Crab Crab Club starts distribution of new song “Homing” that depicts the feelings of two people with a sci-fi worldview
articles.translatedExcerpt: Crab Crab Club released their new song "Homing" today, November 4, 2026 (Wednesday). This work is a sci-fi rock number that depicts the feelings of two people separated by several light years, with the theme of feelings for "you" that never disappear no matter how far apart they are. This is a song that embodies Crab Club's unique worldview, which combines sci-fi ideas with everyday emotions, layering the loneliness and love that everyone knows on a grand space story. In terms of sound, it's guitar rock centered around lightly moving guitar phrases and the dynamic groove of the bass and drums. The bright sound with a sense of speed is layered with the echo of the heartrending lyrics. The jacket consists of an illustration by illustrator "Pin Ponpo." and the title logo of Crab Kani Club's Dr. Ryuto. A music video produced by the two will also be released at a later date.

articles.excerpt: Mollie Elizabethが2026年10月30日(金)にニューEP『People Pleaser』をリリースした。 2025年発表のデビューEP『Dirty Blonde』に続く本作には、全6曲を収録。華やかなキャバレーポップ、オーケストラルなアレンジメント、ドゥーワップの要素、そしてダークなユーモアを融合させた、彼女ならではの独創的な音楽世界が展開されている。 本作の中心にあるテーマは、社会や周囲の人々から押し付けられる期待、そしてそこから自分自身を解放すること。子どもの頃に思い描いていた夢と、成長する中で直面する厳しい現実とのギャップを、独特のストーリーテリングとドラマティックなサウンドで表現している。 リリース情報 https://ototoy.jp/_/default/p/4375290…
articles.translatedTitle: Mollie Elizabeth releases fantastic new EP
articles.translatedExcerpt: Mollie Elizabeth released her new EP “People Pleaser” on Friday, October 30, 2026. This follow-up to their debut EP “Dirty Blonde” released in 2025 includes a total of six songs. Her unique musical world is a fusion of glamorous cabaret pop, orchestral arrangements, doo-wop elements, and dark humor. The central theme of this work is the expectations imposed by society and those around you, and how to free yourself from these expectations. He uses his unique storytelling and dramatic sound to express the gap between the dreams he had as a child and the harsh reality he faces while growing up. articles.translatedTitle: shosha releases introspective new song “Anchor”
articles.translatedExcerpt: shosha released a new single "Anchor" on Wednesday, November 4, 2026. This is his fourth work since the beginning of this year, and it is a song that introspectively depicts the process of being in the midst of love and heading towards its end. The song's lyrics are based on the contradictions and conflicts between the desire to hold back the person who is leaving and the resignation that is accepting the ending, and the title ``Anchor'' is a metaphor for trying to hold on to the heart of someone who is leaving. The sound is a pop-oriented liquid drum and bass. Layering whispering vocal samples, gentle felt piano chords, and a low, crawling Reese bass, they create a quiet yet propulsive beat. Additionally, the album will be released on November 25th (Wednesday). It is scheduled to include a total of 8 songs, including previously released songs that have been released since September.

In preparation for Aina The End's longest hall tour, which will include 22 performances in 19 cities, including Taipei, which was recently lifted, Aina The End is looking for chorus and dancers to work with them to create the stage with the aim of further improving their live performance. In order to give top priority to the quality of the stage, the screening will proceed through a careful selection process, with the policy of not hiring applicants if there are no suitable candidates. In addition to Aina The End herself, the judges include Yukannu, a chorus and dancer who has supported Aina's solo activities since the beginning. Successful candidates will also receive guidance and rehearsals in preparation for the actual performance. Click here for details on recruitment requirements and how to apply https://ainatheend.jp/news/detail.php?id=113…

After the live performance, a teaser video was released for the first time on Kobukuro's official YouTube channel. Yukihiko Tsutsumi, a director and director known for popular TV drama series such as ``Trick'' and ``SPEC'' as well as numerous hit movies, created a short film of 5 episodes inspired by Kobukuro's latest song ``Kasumibiyori''.
